note: governance T13 (spec section 10.1): every non-view external of the nine artifacts, one class each, read by test/governance/SelectorAudit.t.sol against ./out. BIT(n): a holder of bit n, the feature on. OWNER: the owner (revokeRole and setGrant also a live grantor of a delegable grant). HOLDER_OWN: the caller's own role or pending ownership. OWN_BALANCE: the caller's own balance or an allowance its holder granted. SIGNED: a signature of the subject it acts for (a self-call or the DEX's puller only inside a signed settlement). FACTORY: the factory, once. PERMISSIONLESS(reason): anyone, for the reason given. `error`: what a stranger's call with zero arguments reverts with; required on BIT, OWNER, HOLDER_OWN, FACTORY. Written once, then classified by hand; never regenerated to go green.
